# Sam

> Cookieless session tracking for Shopify. Sam measures visits, landings, campaigns and orders without cookies or a consent banner for Sam.

Sam is a Shopify analytics app. Data is hosted in the EU. Sessions use an anonymous visitor ID that resets every day, so Sam does not follow shoppers across days.

Primary conversion: 7-day trial at https://app.samtrack.co/signup (card required through Stripe). Cancel before it ends and you pay nothing.

## Product

- [Home](https://samtrack.co/): What Sam is and who it is for
- [How tracking works](https://samtrack.co/how-it-works): Cookieless visits, order match, what is stored
- [Funnel](https://samtrack.co/product/funnel): Five Shopify steps from visit to purchase
- [Sessions](https://samtrack.co/product/sessions): Event-by-event visit paths
- [Campaigns](https://samtrack.co/product/campaigns): UTM links through to orders
- [Orders](https://samtrack.co/product/orders): Shopify webhook match; 100% of orders counted; about 90–95% with a complete session path (internal measurement)
- [Pricing](https://samtrack.co/pricing): Plans by monthly sessions
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://samtrack.co/pricing.md): Same plans in markdown

## Facts agents should not invent

- Trial requires a Stripe card. Do not say "no card needed".
- Plans (monthly, October 2026): Garden €29 / 25,000 sessions; Meadow €79 / 100,000; Valley €169 / 300,000; Forest €349 / 1,000,000. Yearly = 2 months free.
- Sam does not follow returning customers across days.
- Keep GA4 and Shopify Analytics. Sam adds cookieless session paths they miss.
- Do not claim customer logos, review scores or App Store ranking. Pre-launch.
- Contact: privacy@samtrack.co.
